text: Alliance Leadership Governing Board Governing Board The Governing Board provides organisational stewardship with representation from commercial, research, and public-interest security organisations. The board stewards the Alliance’s mission, priorities, and responsible operation. Its range of perspectives helps connect technical development with product delivery, open ecosystems, research, infrastructure, and public cybersecurity needs. Current board The Governing Board consists of individuals elected by our members for two-year terms, with half of the seats renewed each year, together with one representative from the CHERI Alliance C.I.C. paragraphs: The Governing Board provides organisational stewardship with representation from commercial, research, and public-interest security organisations.

The board stewards the Alliance’s mission, priorities, and responsible operation. Its range of perspectives helps connect technical development with product delivery, open ecosystems, research, infrastructure, and public cybersecurity needs.

The Governing Board consists of individuals elected by our members for two-year terms, with half of the seats renewed each year, together with one representative from the CHERI Alliance C.I.C. Board of Directors.
